# Hey, I am Aravind

### statistics, econometrics, and open-source tooling.

::: {.hero}
![](images/avatar.webp){.hero-photo alt="Aravind Hebbali"}
:::

I build statistical software that holds up outside a tutorial, and I help
teams do the same. My work sits where R, statistics, economics and finance
overlap — regression diagnostics, customer segmentation, descriptive and
inferential statistics, and the unglamorous plumbing that keeps analysis
reproducible.

I am the author of the open-source package portfolio below and six data
science textbooks, and the founder of
[Rsquared Academy](https://www.rsquaredacademy.com/), an open-source education
platform.

I earned my postgraduate degree from
[Madras School of Economics](https://www.mse.ac.in/) (Anna University),
Chennai, and now work independently from Bengaluru, India. The packages are
maintained on my own time and see far more use than I expected.

## Open Source {#open-source}

The portfolio. Everything here is on CRAN, documented, and maintained.

| Package | What it does |
|:--------|:-------------|
| [olsrr](https://olsrr.rsquaredacademy.com) | Tools for building and interpreting OLS regression models |
| [xplorerr](https://xplorerr.rsquaredacademy.com) | Interactive data exploration, visualization and modeling |
| [rfm](https://rfm.rsquaredacademy.com) | Recency, frequency and monetary value analysis for customer segmentation |
| [descriptr](https://descriptr.rsquaredacademy.com) | Fast descriptive statistics and frequency tables for R |
| [rbin](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/rbin) | Bin and group numeric data into intervals |
| [blorr](https://blorr.rsquaredacademy.com) | Tools for developing binary logistic regression models |
| [vistributions](https://vistributions.rsquaredacademy.com) | Visualize probability distributions of univariate data |
| [inferr](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com) | Hypothesis testing and inference for R |
| [yahoofinancer](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/yahoofinancer) | Fetch financial data from Yahoo! Finance |
| [standby](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/standby) | Save, load and manage R processes and sessions |

Reference docs and vignettes for each: [Packages](packages/).

## Consulting & Advisory {#consulting}

**Model validation and econometric audits.** Independent review of
specification, identification and inference. You get a written report, not
just a fixed script.

**Custom package development and architecture.** Internal R or Python tooling
built to survive handover: documented, tested, and structured so your team can
extend it without me.

**Team masterclasses.** Tidyverse, SQL, command-line tooling. Hands-on
sessions built around your own data and problems.

**Who this is for:** teams shipping quantitative work that other people have
to maintain. **Who it is not for:** one-off analyses, or anyone looking for a
pre-packaged answer.
